rationale: A separate finite whole-file bound of ten times the original 30 seconds allows accumulated work across the unchanged 374-line ConstructorState and 212-line InterpretationObservations modules. It is a completion/diagnosis budget, not a measured minimum or a pass at the original bound. A timeout remains censored; no automatic escalation.
buffering: stdbuf -oL -eL plus Lean --json for source-located command diagnostics; no source rewrite
ordering: Sequential; specialized/direct alternated, reversed on second heartbeat repetition. All imports built before timing.
controls: Async omits profiling and Elab.async overrides; sync adds only Elab.async=false. Seconds uses the same synchronous trace configuration as heartbeats but a monotonic wall clock. Counts and wall profiles are separate runs.
coordination: Request the other active implementation agent to pause Lean compilation for the measured window; shared host, no CPU isolation. Load averages retained per run.
original_evidence: clients-results.json remains unchanged, including the censored 30-second rows and original async controls.
buffering_fixture: Before client timing: unchanged temporary two-command fixture, first a proved arithmetic example then 10s sleeping IO; 4s process bound, run once with default buffering and once line-buffered. Retain all partial output; fixture only diagnoses completed-message capture, not classifier cost.
aggregation: Parse source-located JSON command traces; retain all raw traces, but sum only maximal nonoverlapping source ranges. Nested scoped-option expansion traces are enclosed by the inclusive parent. Missing/reversed ranges, equal outermost ranges or nonnested overlap yield no aggregate and explicit diagnostic. Never present failed-file totals as successful costs.
preliminary_disposition: Four preliminary rows exposed separate scoped-option expansion roots. They are retained outside the final matrix; final runs restart with the tested source-range aggregation. Budgets, repetitions and client sources are unchanged.
